body:
MXP REPORT
~90 MG PARACHUTED (smoked cannabis some time before)
Haven't ate much, experienced with MXE and K.
21:51   Took it with water.
22:00   Starting to feel a weak and fluid body high, minor headache, it's harder to play online tetris. (fast onset somehow)
22:11   Breathing becomes heavier. Minor heartbeat increase. (Could be slight anxiety)
22:19   Hardly noticable waves of watery body high.
22:55   Wibbly-wobbly slightly drunk walk, geometric perception kind of off. Still nothing major.
23:31   Making some ambient music with my MikroKorg while lying on my bed, feeling wobbly and light bodied. Slight increase in musical appreciation. Synths lights flickering more abnormally and the headache is still here.
23:42   Opening my window to take a toke of some sweet chibba feels weird (FOV seems more open).
00:08   Feeling heavy drunk body high, playing MikroKorg is the sweetest thing, music definitely makes me feel complex. Opening icecream. Tastes real weird, spacy, wow.
00:56   FUCK YEAH, AMBIENT KINGDOM CONQUERED, HEAVY DISSOCIATIVE EFFEX BRO. takin another hit of dat cheebbbbaa.
01:00   Would not drive a car. I'm melting in the groundd-d-dd-d..
01:14   I just listened to the best ambient album ever made by me, wow the fuck, shit was INCREDIBLE! Heavily sedated due to weed coming with me. My korgs power adapter sprung out the wall, now I have to experiment further with a new sound. Fuck yeah!
02:24   It's truly something. Cosmos. Time is chaotic.
02:28   It is not MXE, but it is similar in a way.. I hope I'll sleep well. Motor skills = few. Enough to pour water. And writing is slowww.. deepness all arounddd. Introspective. pow-pow-pow.
02:31   Drowsy af. My lil' bro is sleep-talking, shieet. Matr1x. I have lectures after 8 hours..
02:33   life=best if u can see what I see. I love that I can't describe my thoughts. I can only write that I can't describe them.
02:35   I did not anticipate that I'd get what I've wanted. I hope you have nice 'erb.
~~~~~~  Perception of my body was more twisted than 10 players playing a 4 player twister. Fell asleep somewhere at 04:00 quite easily.
12:44  Woke up with a headache, missed my Academy and I don't feel a significant afterglow. It was great, not MXE, but recommendable.
Visuals gave me a fuzzy outlook, nothing more. Walking was impaired because the length of my legs was changing with every step.
MXE gave me better control of my feeling control centre. This was not as clear as I wanted it it be.
